dedupe_keys.name: the outer radiation belt electron neural net model

description: ORIENT estimates outer-radiation-belt electron fluxes with machine learning. It uses histories of solar-wind conditions and geomagnetic indices together with location, trained against Van Allen Probes measurements. The resource is documented by UCLA. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Missing or inaccurate real-time geomagnetic indices can prevent reliable model inputs. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
